Lady Annalie: First Melissa, and now you two too?! I’m gonna be left all alone here!
Whenever Melissa is mentioned, it feels like a dagger is piercing my heart…
#Annalie.face.sad
You: Come on now, you still will have your other friends.
Lady Annalie: Well…
Lady Annalie: They don’t really live here anymore. I mean, we meet each other from time to time, but only when they have some business here, but that is beside the point!
Lady Annalie: Why now?
